content: Liva̱nen simounid
Kukin bitasimounid aveiyag bitaban mo bitanamis, mapuna takakin-wan. Tut towen nag bitakin youd tasiyas, tage tasimounids peinan takakinsa nisesus.
Butus tammwayas bo taliganes, peinan isimounids waseg Yowbad.
Tasimounids mo takakins peinan ven babaw Yowbad nibun, anilivan waseg. Mamagina ikow youd tasiyas nag bitakin, waseg mo ibun youd babaw nitakin.

Kweiboug Eibel isimounid, mo ilun Yowbad waseg, Yowbad bo ikalin nuwan Eibel inalun waseg, tage tuwan inalun Yowbad nag ikalin nuwan. Mapuna Yowbad idok Eibel tadidumwal. Bo ikanig Eibel; tage liva̱nen mtowen nawotet igawa ikatimlakeids, peinan tasimounid towen.
Inok-vak isimounid, Yowbad mo ikow inow. Nag ikanig. Nag biba̱nes mtowen ven watinow, nag; peinan Yowbad bo ikow inow. Kweiboug Inok nises ven watinow, iliva̱nes kid Yowbad ikalin nuwan waseg.
Kukin nag bitasimounid, ta-ma̱wan Yowbad bikalin nuwan wasigeis ya̱kids. Kukin kal binek Yowbad, bikakin-wan Yowbad mounid nises o bisimounid-vak Yowbad bisiwyoubus tasiyas ininekes.

Kweiboug Yowbad ikatimlek Now mo ikakin aveiyag igaw mo bivag. Now nag ikin youd tasiyas. Igaw-wan, tage bo isimounid, ivkaes inawag, waseg ikatinob angamag. Now ansinap didumwal, waseg ikamtel gamag babaw asisinap kalbaleb, mo iyous ansinap didumwal, peinan isimounid.
Wankuyeim Ebelam isimounid Yowbad aygan, mo ikanaway, ilisow naven, inoun in silma̱nin ven kweivaw Yowbad nikatigik inaven. E, inoun in, tage nag ikakin avanuy bein.

Isimounid, mapuna isiwas ven towen Yowbad nikatigik siven, siney Aysak, Yekob. Mamagina bwabwal tasiyas. Sibunatum man kaleivin. E, Yowbad bo ilivnek siven tasiyas Ebelam natun son tabun, ma̱wana nikatigik Ebelam inaven.
Ebelam bo inamis igaw beisiw ven tawtoun waseg, ven towen Yowbad nibun.
Nakwav Sela bo ivnavek, tage isimounid, mo itawtoun won, isum, peinan ikakin towen nilivnek igaw mo bitoukum ma̱wana nilivnek.
E taninuways. Tatanok gamag Ebelam anbweilim bo ikous, mo ivag tibun singaya babaw, ma̱wana wutun o alekel babiweis.

Tammwayas tasiyas isimounids ee... ikanka̱nigs. Nag iba̱nes youd towen Yowbad nilivnek. Tage bo ikines kadiveiyov, ikalin nuwes peinan. Idokes tatineis sikabgobwaw mamagina bwabwal tasiyas igaw ven watinow nisesus.
Kukin kalisiy ninous ma̱wan mo binineivs siven tatineis.
Kukin bininuways-wan ven towen nilisawes mo biba̱nes siked va̱gan beiyums.
Tage sivines kid kweivaw ven bwanabwein, walba̱lab nises. Mapuna Yowbad nag ivag anmwasin, peinan idokes siYowbad. E, bo ikatineg siven.
Kweiboug Yowbad niyakwen Ebelam, tage isimounid bwein, itam natun anmwa̱net, beiweiy mamagina lun bulukwan kid. Liva̱nen towen Aysak, Yowbad nilivnek, ilana,

Tage Ebelam bo isimounid, itam natun towen. Idok Yowbad kadiloka biyakit takanig; mamagina kabebay waseg natun Aysak beimat, Yowbad mo biyakit vayuwein bisek Ebelam. E, Ebelam isimounid mo Yowbad ileb natun mwamovan silma̱nin.
Wankuyeim Aysak isimounid mo ilivnek sikabmwa̱saw Yekob son Isaw.
Wankuyeim Yekob kakita beimat, isimounid, anilivan bwein mo ikatigik pines Yosep nitun tawaw asteiy, igawa geg ikkulul wakunuwatan nakaytuk.
Wankuyeim Yosep, bo ikous anbweilim, mo ilivan liva̱nen taliven min-Yisleil peinan bilisawes Yidipt beiyums, ilana,
Wankuyeim Moses inan nikop natun, isimounids son namwan mo isowmes kweitoun tibukon, peinan ikakinsa a̱pwaw tamnabwein, o nag iwenes king inakaleiwag.
Wankuyeim Moses ivakaein, isimounid waseg Yowbad, nanon ilana,

content.text: “Awoum gamag ninous bilansa, ‘Adok inan mana̱wen Pelow natun’; awoum.”

content: Sivinan gog abes bigeg siney Yowbad nagamag. Nag sivinan bimwa̱saw tut kayakus waseg sinap kalbaleb.
Nanon ilana,

content.text: “Awoum bakow Yidipt wuliyougwan. Bweina biyagageigs peinan Kelis angamag yey. Towen waseg igaw mo bamwa̱saw, mamagina maysan gunawotet.”

content: E, isimounid mo itokes min-Yisleil ilisawes Yidipt. Nag iwen king towen nikawkun. Ivvalut-wan. Mamagina bo ikin Yowbad, tage matan nag ikin, tage bo isimounida-wan.
Isimounid mo isagal, Kaltuwon sigeilin. La̱miy buya̱vin iwlik. Awoum ge towen tawayin gamags beisiw wasibunatum beiweiys kunutaws.
Asibabaw isimounids mo ikallituwanis Yol Bwabwel, mamagina pwepway nibunab nikalituwanis. Wankuyeim min-Yidipt iyokons, bo nag; mo iwgweles.
Wankuyeim tasiyas nisiwunis ven yagan Yelikow yam kweinim kweiy waseg, isimounids, isiwunis ven towen, boul palatan palatan mo ikalivatow.
Wankuyeim nakubukwab ma̱nawen Leyab nisimounid ilabes Yosuw nagamag tasiyas asteiy takinwunins ven, mana̱wen Leyab nag iweiys; tage tasiyas takapidabs iwaweiysa ikous.
Ta-ma̱wan bitakavtagis yiges asibabaw tasiyas tasimounids, peinan singay babaw. Gidiyon, Ba̱lak, Samson, Yepitak, Deibid, Samwel o tasiyas palopits.

Tasiyas isimounids mo naviy waseg itawtouns wasigeis ven kawka̱veks, ikaleiwags asisinap didumwal waseg, iba̱nes youd tasiyas Yowbad nilivnek, iva̱ges mo ituk ninous mansiyas la̱yon; nag igades; kov singay avakaein isiwmates; ikatinabwes tatineis naviy waseg; tougweys tasiyas mo itawtouns; itawtouns naviy waseg; ikawsapes takanaviys tasiyas nivvatays wasigeis.

Vinay mwasanin asigamag bo ikits kanig waseg. Tasiyas takalbalebs ivvasiganis Yowbad nagamag mwasanin, ivvalutsa bo nag, peinan isimounids. Kukin bipiyaves Yowbad, mo beikous takalbalebs siwaway wasigeis. Nag gog, isimounids-wan. Igaw bimta̱mats, sivines beikits vayuwein mwa̱saw avakaein waseg.
Bo isiba̱wes Yowbad inagamags mwasanin, mwasanin iwaweiys vatul waseg, mwasanin iyawanis nimes o kikeis vatul waseg, mwananin isenas wanuwan deil.

Mwasanin iwaweiys dakul waseg. Mwasanin ita̱vis paley; mwasanin iwaweiys pulut tanmunun waseg. Yowbad nagamag mwasanin asikweim kulivis mansiyas sip o gouts, ininounasa-wan, ta-ivag siven, abes igeg peinan gamag niybilebes.
Ven watinow nag ibunakes, peinan kalbaleb. Gamag babaw ikamliwes, mapuna inounas ineis nawoud makaw waseg; mwasanin ineis wa̱koy; sibunatum mwasanin leg o mwasanin takunumwan.
Butus asibabaw tasiyas bo taliganes, peinan isimounids waseg Yowbad. Tage nag iba̱nes youd towen nilivnek.
Peinan youd towen bwanabwein Yowbad ikakin igaw mo bisekeids ya̱kids. Sidayas tasiyas mo bitalivatus youd babaw bwanabwein.
